thread:
liz: Kicking off a short follow-up thread from the ACME private deployment postmortem. Main items: VPC peering flaps, on-prem load constraints, and isolation bug triage. Assigning owners and timelines here.
omar: Thanks — quick context: root cause was stale route propagation + a lock in the on-prem switch that delayed failover. We saw 2 similar flaps in last 6 weeks.
raul: FYI I've already opened a ticket for the switch vendor - HW-4782. Vendor expects next-week firmware.
rachel: Action items we promised ACME: 1) confirm peering stability, 2) provide mitigation docs, 3) timeline for firmware. We should list owners and ETA.
liz: Agreed. My initial assignment: peering stability runbook update — owner @omar, ETA 3 business days.
omar: Taking peering runbook. Will add explicit checklists: BGP neighbour state, route table counts, and script to auto-reconcile missing routes. ETA EOD +3.
raul: I'll own vendor coordination and firmware schedule. ETA: vendor confirms 2026-03-30 for staging, 2026-04-06 for prod.
liz: Isolation bug (KV cache leak causing cross-tenant latency spikes) — owner @raul for a short PoC fix, owner @omar for permanent fix. Raul, can you estimate?
raul: PoC in 48h to roll a per-tenant cache cap. If PoC looks good, we can ship a config toggle to Dedicated within 1 week.
omar: Permanent fix needs some runtime refactor (KV eviction by tenant). Estimate 3 sprints. Will add a canary + automatic rollback to rollout plan.
rachel: ACME asked for a mitigation doc and a targeted timeline. I'll send them an interim mitigation note today with the PoC ETA and vendor firmware dates.
liz: Good. I'll create a consolidated action tracker here with owners, tickets, and due dates. Quick list: 
- PEER-001: Peering runbook update — owner: omar — due: 2026-03-26 — PR: TKT-7890
- PEER-002: Auto-route reconcile script — owner: omar — due: 2026-03-28 — PR: TKT-7891
- VEND-001: Vendor firmware coordination HW-4782 — owner: raul — vendor ETA: 2026-03-30 (staging)
- CACHE-POC: Per-tenant KV cap PoC — owner: raul — due: 2026-03-24 — PR: TKT-7895
- CACHE-FIX: Runtime eviction change — owner: omar — due: 2026-04-20 
- MITIGATE-ACME: Interim mitigation doc — owner: rachel — due: 2026-03-23

sre-bot: Reminder: create follow-up incidents in the tracker and add postmortem tag.
liz: Also adding recurring incident pattern item: Investigate why two flaps in 6 weeks. Owner: liz & raul — due 2026-04-02.
omar: I'll instrument additional metrics for peering jitter and route churn and add them to the console dashboards (per-route latency, BGP state change counts). ETA: 5 days.
raul: Noted. For the on-prem switch, vendor asked for logs: please run 
```
show tech-support | redirect tftp://10.0.0.5/acme-switch-logs
```
and share with me.
rachel: I'll coordinate with ACME ops to run that tonight and upload to the case.
liz: One more operational mitigation we discussed: a temporary routing policy to prefer backup paths while vendor fixes firmware. Owner: omar — will push as a canary policy with a 60m rollback.
omar: Will draft the policy and post the canary deploy playbook in #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary-policy-vpc-preference -> staging. ID: DEPLOY-9021.
liz: Thanks all. I'll update the consolidated tracker and ping tomorrow for a quick standup. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here and tag me. :thumbsup:
